## Four different questions about one dataset

A machine-learning dataset does not force one type of model. We choose a formulation according to the decision we need to make.

**Regression:** Given distance $d$ and item count $n$, estimate fulfilment time $t$.

$$
\hat t=\beta_0+\beta_1d+\beta_2n.
$$

**Dimensionality reduction:** Without using fulfilment-time labels, turn two measured features into a compact representation while preserving as much variation as possible.

$$
z=\boldsymbol w^\top(\boldsymbol x-\boldsymbol\mu),\qquad\|\boldsymbol w\|_2=1.
$$

**Density estimation:** Model the observed distribution of times, potentially with two different operating regimes.

$$
p(t)=\sum_{k=1}^{K}\pi_k\mathcal N(t\mid\mu_k,\sigma_k^2).
$$

**Classification:** Decide whether a delivery is late or on time, based on a defined threshold and feature representation.

$$
\hat y=\operatorname{sign}(\boldsymbol w^\top\boldsymbol x+b).
$$

These are distinct learning problems. PCA and GMM do not need time or classification labels; regression and SVM do.

## The bridge: objectives and assumptions

A model includes a hypothesis class, a loss or likelihood and a fitting algorithm. For squared-error regression we might use gradient descent or solve least squares directly; for GMM we might use expectation-maximisation; for SVM we solve a constrained margin optimisation.

The same procedure can overfit if evaluated only on training data. Split data by the anticipated deployment setting, prevent leakage and measure generalisation.

## Verify with the same Python file

~~~bash
python3 ai-mathematics/examples/delivery_ml_lab.py regression
python3 ai-mathematics/examples/delivery_ml_lab.py pca
python3 ai-mathematics/examples/delivery_ml_lab.py gmm
python3 ai-mathematics/examples/delivery_ml_lab.py svm
~~~

The SVM demo illustrates a valid boundary but does not train a maximum-margin classifier; the GMM example illustrates EM on one-dimensional times, not a production clustering system. Read each chapter's limitations before extrapolating its results.
